title: Peggy's Cove Round Trip Transport from Halifax with Scenic Drive
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Discover the charming fishing village of Peggy's Cove on this transport from Halifax. With a focus on the village’s iconic lighthouse and stunning coastline, enjoy a leisurely exploration at your own pace. This journey includes a comfortable eco-friendly ride through the beautiful landscapes of Nova Scotia, allowing for scenic views along the way. After visiting the quaint village and capturing memorable photos, you'll return to Halifax, reflecting on the area's rich beauty and history.

- featuring highlights like the famous Peggy's Cove lighthouse
- Explore the picturesque fishing village at your own pace
- Comfortable eco-friendly transport from Halifax with scenic views

To ensure the best experience, our shared tours run with a small-group maximum of 7 guests per vehicle (utilizing Sedans, SUVs, or Minivans). Please note that a minimum of 3 bookings is required for the tour to operate. If this requirement is not met, we will notify you regarding cancellation and a full refund.
